newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SAO PAULO STOCK EXCHANGE VOLUME $22.3 BLN IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: SAO PAULO STOCK EXCHANGE VOLUME $22.3 BLN IN JULY.

text.p: Market turnover at the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) in July totalled $22.3 billion, with an average daily volume of $1.0 billion, down 9.7 percent from the previous month, the bolsa said.
The spot market accounted for 90.3 percent of total trade, followed by the options market with 9.1 percent and the forward market with 0.6 percent, it said in a statement.

Local financial institutions accounted for 40 percent of the bolsa's total volume, while foreign investors represented 26.4 percent, followed by institutional investors with 19.5 percent, individuals with 11 percent, and other types of investors making up the balance.
The stock exchange also said the Bovespa index, comprising the 47 most liquid stocks, rose 2.4 percent in July.
